# Native job draft for #169

Model family: OpenAI GPT-6.1 (Codex, gpt-6.1-sol); startup.json names a different startup model.
Created four new draft files under [benchmark/native/job/](../benchmark/native/job/README.md); pinned files remain unchanged.
The host driver stages declared VIs, hashes originals/copies before and after, uses the pinned network-disabled container pattern, and writes template-shaped records and output hashes.
The container script proposes built-in HTML printing and an EXIT CloseLabVIEW trap, with file capture.
The dispatch-only workflow uses read-only permissions, disables persisted credentials, and uploads records, manifests and logs only.
[The README](../benchmark/native/job/README.md) maps every readiness clause and identifies unverified operations, parameters and safety behaviour.
The synthetic self-test exited 0 and rejected five mutations: changed source, missing output, extra output, enabled networking and changed working copy.
Shell syntax and the evaluator evidence-index check also exited 0; these checks establish no native result.
No Docker or LabVIEW execution, readiness determination or quality measurement was performed.

## Discoveries
Native properties, substantive diagram capture, safe loading and controlled I/O remain gaps; see [the clause map](../benchmark/native/job/README.md#readiness-clause-map).
The upload restriction leaves HTML on the disposable runner, preventing substantive comparison through the proposed artifact; see [the transfer gap](../benchmark/native/job/README.md#proposed-installation-and-artifact-boundary).

## What next
Policymaker should order independent cross-family review, then file one Owner question with the documented installation steps and unresolved prerequisites. Resume from the four saved draft files; avoid repeating startup reads, running Docker, altering pinned designs or inferring behaviour from hashes or HTML filenames.
